---
name: Documentation problem
about: Something on the documentation website is wrong, unclear or missing
title: "[Docs] "
labels: documentation
---

**Page**
The address of the page (for example https://asfandyarkhan72.github.io/PINNStudio/guide/training/) and the section.

**What is wrong or unclear**
What the page says, and what is wrong, out of date or hard to follow. If the page does not match what PINNStudio
shows, say what the window shows instead (a screenshot helps).

**Version**
The PINNStudio version you are using (`pip show pinnstudio`; for a source install, also the commit from
`git rev-parse --short HEAD`).

**Suggested change** (optional)
How the text could read instead, or what is missing.
